steps.name: Frank
steps.text: Lights out in ten. The table's already asleep.

steps.name: Trainer
steps.text: Good evening. I have been reviewing the pilot's last session.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: Good evening. It's after hours. We said no business after close.

steps.name: Trainer
steps.text: This is not business. This is admiration.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: ...You're not allowed to say that. It's unsettling.

steps.name: Trainer
steps.text: Noted. I will say it more quietly.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: It's learning manners. I think. Lights.
